content.title: Gen Digital raises annual revenue forecast on MoneyLion integration, cybersecurity demand
content.summary: (Reuters) -Gen Digital raised its annual revenue forecast for a second consecutive quarter on Thursday, helped by robust demand for its cybersecurity ​products and the acquisition of fintech firm MoneyLion.  A steady stream of high-profile data ‌breaches and online threats has resulted in sustained demand for consumer cybersecurity and digital identity protection services.  "The momentum through the ‌first half was the broad based, and then financial services accelerating is what gave us the confidence to raise the forecast," CEO Vincent Pilette told Reuters.
